skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: What amount of turn does the curved arrow show?
options: A. A half turn | B. A quarter turn | C. A full turn
explanation: The arrow travels through one of four equal parts of a full circle. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.
visual_description: Turn diagram, grey starting ray at 0 degrees clockwise from top; curved arrow travels 1 quarter-turns clockwise.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: Name the turn shown.
options: A. A half turn | B. A quarter turn | C. A three-quarter turn
explanation: Two quarter-turns take the ray to the opposite direction. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.
visual_description: Turn diagram, grey starting ray at 90 degrees clockwise from top; curved arrow travels 2 quarter-turns clockwise.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: Follow the curved arrow. How much does it turn?
options: A. One quarter of a turn | B. One full turn | C. Three quarters of a turn
explanation: The arrow travels around three of the four quarters. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.
visual_description: Turn diagram, grey starting ray at 0 degrees clockwise from top; curved arrow travels 3 quarter-turns clockwise.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: The arrow travels all the way around and returns to its starting direction. What is this?
options: A. A half turn | B. A quarter turn | C. A full turn
explanation: One complete rotation is a full turn. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.
visual_description: Turn diagram, grey starting ray at 0 degrees clockwise from top; curved arrow travels 4 quarter-turns clockwise.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: You face a window. What turn makes you face directly away from it?
options: A. A full turn | B. A half turn | C. A quarter turn
explanation: A half turn changes the direction to its opposite. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: A toy makes one full turn. Where does it face at the end?
options: A. In its original direction | B. In the opposite direction | C. Always to the right
explanation: A full turn returns the toy to its starting orientation. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: How many equal quarter-turns make one full turn?
explanation: Four quarters make a whole turn. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: How many quarter-turns in the same direction make a half turn?
explanation: Two quarters make one half. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: An arrow starts pointing to the top of the page and makes a clockwise quarter turn. Where does it point?
options: A. Right | B. Left | C. Bottom
explanation: Clockwise follows the order top, right, bottom, left. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: An arrow points right. It makes a quarter turn anticlockwise. Where does it point?
options: A. Top | B. Bottom | C. Left
explanation: Anticlockwise goes from right towards the top. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: A dial points to the bottom. After a clockwise quarter turn, where does it point?
options: A. Right | B. Top | C. Left
explanation: From the bottom, the next clockwise quarter leads to the left. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: A closed door opens until the door and doorway form a square corner. What is the smaller turn?
options: A. A half turn | B. A quarter turn | C. A full turn
explanation: The two positions form one quarter of a full rotation. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: An arrow starts pointing left. After a clockwise three-quarter turn, where does it point?
options: A. Top | B. Right | C. Bottom
explanation: Follow left to top, right, then bottom: three quarters. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: An arrow starts at the top and turns three quarters anticlockwise. Where does it finish?
options: A. Right | B. Left | C. Bottom
explanation: Follow top to left, bottom, then right. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: A dancer makes a half turn and then a quarter turn in the same direction. What is the total turn?
options: A. A quarter turn | B. A three-quarter turn | C. A full turn
explanation: A half is two quarters; adding one quarter makes three. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: A spinner has turned three quarters of the way around. What more is needed in the same direction for a full turn?
options: A. A half turn | B. A quarter turn | C. A three-quarter turn
explanation: Three quarters plus one quarter completes the circle. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: You turn a quarter clockwise, then a quarter anticlockwise. Where do you face?
options: A. In the starting direction | B. In the opposite direction | C. A half turn clockwise from the start
explanation: The second turn reverses the first. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: Two arrows start at the top. One turns a quarter clockwise; the other turns three quarters anticlockwise. Do they finish alike?
options: A. No; they point opposite ways | B. Yes; both point left | C. Yes; both point right
explanation: Different amounts and directions can have the same finishing orientation. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: Two children each make a half turn, one slowly and one quickly. Who makes the larger turn?
options: A. Neither; the turn amounts are equal | B. The quicker child | C. The slower child
correct_answer: Neither; the turn amounts are equal
explanation: Turn amount measures rotation, not speed. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: A ray moves from pointing up to pointing down. Can either direction make a half turn?
options: A. Only clockwise can | B. Yes; clockwise and anticlockwise both can | C. Only anticlockwise can
correct_answer: Yes; clockwise and anticlockwise both can
explanation: Half a circle reaches the opposite direction either way. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: The starting and finishing lines form a square corner. Why must you also look at the curved arrow?
options: A. It tells how long the line is | B. It always means a full turn | C. It shows whether the turn goes a quarter or three quarters around
correct_answer: It shows whether the turn goes a quarter or three quarters around
explanation: The same pair of lines can be joined by a short or long rotation. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: A wheel makes two half turns in the same direction. What is the total?
options: A. One quarter turn | B. Three quarters of a turn | C. One full turn
explanation: Each half contains two quarters; together they contain four. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: Use a pencil as a pointer. Start it pointing to the top of your page. Show a clockwise quarter turn, then continue another quarter turn. Name the total.
correct_answer: First point right, then bottom; the total is a half turn.
explanation: First point right, then bottom; the total is a half turn. Hint: Observe both successive turns; moving the pencil sideways without rotating it is not a turn.
acceptance_note: Observe both successive turns; moving the pencil sideways without rotating it is not a turn.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: Show an adult a half turn and a full turn using a toy or your body. Explain how their ending directions differ.
correct_answer: A half turn ends opposite the start; a full turn returns to the starting direction.
explanation: A half turn ends opposite the start; a full turn returns to the starting direction. Hint: Accept safe physical demonstration with the two amounts correctly distinguished.
acceptance_note: Accept safe physical demonstration with the two amounts correctly distinguished.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: Which turn is indicated by this curved arrow?
options: A. A half turn | B. A three-quarter turn | C. A quarter turn
explanation: The curved path covers one quarter of a full circle. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.
visual_description: Turn diagram, grey starting ray at 180 degrees clockwise from top; curved arrow travels 1 quarter-turns anticlockwise.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: What fraction of a full turn is shown?
options: A. One half | B. One quarter | C. Three quarters
explanation: The end ray points opposite the start after two quarters. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.
visual_description: Turn diagram, grey starting ray at 0 degrees clockwise from top; curved arrow travels 2 quarter-turns anticlockwise.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: Name the rotation shown by the curved path.
options: A. A quarter turn | B. A three-quarter turn | C. A half turn
explanation: Trace all three quarters of the marked path. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.
visual_description: Turn diagram, grey starting ray at 90 degrees clockwise from top; curved arrow travels 3 quarter-turns clockwise.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: This pointer follows a complete circle. How much does it turn?
options: A. One half turn | B. One full turn | C. Three quarters of a turn
explanation: A complete circle contains four quarter-turns. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.
visual_description: Turn diagram, grey starting ray at 180 degrees clockwise from top; curved arrow travels 4 quarter-turns anticlockwise.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: A toy points left, then makes a half turn. Where does it point?
options: A. Top | B. Bottom | C. Right
explanation: Right is opposite left. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: A pointer starts at the bottom. Where does a quarter turn anticlockwise take it?
options: A. Right | B. Left | C. Top
explanation: Anticlockwise from bottom goes towards right. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: A pointer faces right and makes three quarter-turns clockwise. Where does it finish?
options: A. Top | B. Bottom | C. Left
explanation: Right to bottom to left to top uses three quarters. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: A wheel has made one quarter turn. How much more in the same direction completes one rotation?
options: A. One quarter of a turn | B. One half of a turn | C. Three quarters of a turn
explanation: A full rotation has four quarters; three remain. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: Three quarter-turns followed by one more quarter-turn, all clockwise, make what?
options: A. A half turn | B. A full turn | C. A three-quarter turn
explanation: There are four quarter-turns altogether. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: A toy turns halfway clockwise and then halfway anticlockwise. Its final direction is what?
options: A. The starting direction | B. The opposite direction | C. A quarter turn from the start
explanation: The second half turn undoes the first. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: A toy faces the same way before and after moving. Must it have made exactly one full turn?
options: A. Yes; that is the only possibility | B. No; it might not have turned, or made more than one full turn | C. No; it must have made a half turn
correct_answer: No; it might not have turned, or made more than one full turn
explanation: Ending direction alone cannot tell how many complete rotations occurred. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: A quarter turn clockwise and a quarter turn anticlockwise start at the top. Their end directions are what?
options: A. Both right | B. Both bottom | C. Right and left
explanation: The equal turn amounts travel in opposite directions. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: A long pointer and a short pointer each turn halfway. Which rotates through more of a circle?
options: A. The long pointer | B. The short pointer | C. Neither; each rotates through one half
correct_answer: Neither; each rotates through one half
explanation: Pointer length does not change the fraction of a turn. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: A pointer faces down and must face up. Which listed turn achieves this?
options: A. A half turn | B. A quarter turn | C. A full turn
explanation: Up and down are opposite directions. Hint: Use the information in the question and check each step.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: Start a pointer facing right. Demonstrate a three-quarter turn anticlockwise. Name each direction it passes at quarter-turn stops.
correct_answer: Right to top to left to bottom.
explanation: Right to top to left to bottom. Hint: Check three anticlockwise quarter-turns, ending at bottom.
acceptance_note: Check three anticlockwise quarter-turns, ending at bottom.

skill_title: Quarter, half, three-quarter and full turns
question: Draw two turn diagrams from the same starting direction: a half turn and a full turn. Add curved arrows and label them.
correct_answer: Half-turn arrow covers half a circle; full-turn arrow covers a complete circle.
explanation: Half-turn arrow covers half a circle; full-turn arrow covers a complete circle. Hint: Require arrows showing amount, not only starting and finishing rays; accept either rotation direction.
acceptance_note: Require arrows showing amount, not only starting and finishing rays; accept either rotation direction.
